messages:
Noah (People Ops): Quick note  new manager Elena Rivera starts next Mon. I sketched an "Orchard" compact checklist (preboard -> week1) for managers focused on tech access + people ops. Pls add gaps. TL;DR below.
Elena Rivera: Thanks! Two Qs: laptop arrival day0? GitHub org access? and can I get an infra buddy for demos?
Raj (IT): If procurement ticket in by Thu we should be able to ship for Day0. We handle Okta/GSuite + GitHub invites. Please open ticket with this template: ```Title: New manager device + access - Elena Rivera
Start: 2026-08-03
Team: Eng - Runtime
Device: Macbook Pro 14 / existing
Needs: Okta, GSuite, GitHub org (write), AWS staging read, Vault read, SSH key register
Manager approver: Kai
```
Raj (IT): Note: prod/KMS access requires written justification and manager approval. If you have an existing corporate laptop reply here and we'll skip procurement.
Kai (Infra): I can buddy wk1 for infra walkthroughs. Day2 I'll demo the staging cluster, deploy flow, and the demo pool fast path. For short demo pools (<8h) request in #eng-infra with purpose, region, qps, retention.
Marta (Finance): For expense/virtual card: manager signoff + headcount code needed. Virtual card often same-week after approvals; physical card 5-7 days. Email finance@redwood.com with headcount code.
onboard-bot: Calendar event created: "Manager Preboard - Elena Rivera" invited: elena.rivera@redwood.com.
Noah (People Ops): Orchard compact checklist (preboard -> week1):
- Preboard (3-5 days before): procurement ticket, headcount code to Finance, Okta invite sent, enroll MFA, GitHub invite pending manager approval.
- Day0 (eve): confirm device tracking # or pickup, create calendar seats for intro meetings, confirm virtual card status.
- Day1: 30m manager 1:1 + access verification (Okta/GitHub/AWS), security quickstart, set SSH key.
- Day2: infra buddy walkthrough (staging, deploy flow, demo pool request), meet product partner.
- Day3: pair on small triage/PR + meet direct reports 1:1s.
- Day4: draft and share 30/60/90 (top 3 measurable outcomes per milestone), tag manager for feedback.
- Day5: kickoff first ownership task + week1 retro, confirm any remaining approvals (KMS/Vault).
Elena Rivera: MFA done, GitHub invite pending. I'll paste SSH pubkey here once invite accepted. Will share 30/60/90 draft by Fri.
Raj (IT): GitHub invite sent. If you don't see it check spam and Okta status. For SSH: generate locally and paste public key into the ticket or add in GitHub settings.
Kai (Infra): For demo pools: fast path if requested before 3pm PT. Include expected concurrency and retention hours. I can usually approve small demos same-day.
Marta (Finance): Elena - please DM me headcount code and estimated monthly spend for a virtual card and I'll start approvals.
Noah (People Ops): Great. I'll follow up with Procurement + IT on device ETA and close the checklist once all items are green. Welcome Elena! :tada:
